criteria.name: Workspace & Git setup
criteria.description: Free Edition workspace and Git folder connected to GitHub. Notebooks commit in Source format, and the control plane vs compute plane split is explained in the learner's own words.

criteria.name: Unity Catalog structure
criteria.description: Catalog with bronze, silver and gold schemas. A Volume-backed governed table with visible lineage, and a clear, correct governance note.

criteria.name: Access control & security
criteria.description: GRANT and REVOKE demonstrated. Row filter and column mask expressed as SQL functions, with the service-principal rationale for production explained.

criteria.name: Delta Lake operations
criteria.description: History read correctly, time travel by version and timestamp, schema evolution, Liquid Clustering with OPTIMIZE, safe VACUUM and a verified MERGE upsert.

criteria.name: Ingestion design
criteria.description: Idempotent COPY INTO, incremental Auto Loader on the availableNow trigger, nested JSON flattened, and a justified tool-choice table.

criteria.name: Transformation & modeling
criteria.description: Silver is typed and deduplicated, and Gold aggregates and views are chosen deliberately. Joins and the query plan are understood, and the data quality check is asserted.

criteria.name: Declarative pipelines
criteria.description: Bronze and silver streaming tables and a gold materialized view run end-to-end, with an expectation that drops the bad row and metrics read correctly.

criteria.name: Orchestration & CI/CD
criteria.description: Multi-task job with dependencies, a parameter, a trigger, retries and an alert tested by a real failure. Bundle validated and deployed to dev and prod from the CLI.

criteria.name: Performance diagnosis
criteria.description: Skew, shuffle and spill found in the query profile, with before/after numbers for the fix and a credible diagnosis of the slowest job run.

criteria.name: Self-service analytics
criteria.description: Three-visual AI/BI dashboard on Gold, a working SQL alert, and a curated Genie space whose generated SQL has been checked.

criteria.name: Experiment tracking
criteria.description: Autologged, manual and AutoML (or fallback) runs compared in MLflow, with a reasoned production recommendation.

criteria.name: Features & Feature Store
criteria.description: EDA findings acted on, meaningful engineered features, a Unity Catalog feature table with a timeseries key, and a point-in-time training set with leakage explained.

criteria.name: Model quality & deployment
criteria.description: Spark ML pipeline cross-validated, Optuna search logged as nested runs, metric choice justified, model registered with @champion, and batch predictions written.

criteria.name: Retrieval & grounding
criteria.description: Chunked corpus with Change Data Feed, a working AI Search index, relevant top-k results, and traced answers checked for grounding.

criteria.name: Agent design & tool routing
criteria.description: Two well-described tools, correct tool choice across mixed questions, and traces kept for every test.

criteria.name: Governed deployment
criteria.description: Agent registered in Unity Catalog and served, or deployment steps documented precisely where the tier blocks it.

criteria.name: Cost & architecture narrative
criteria.description: DBU usage reviewed with three concrete savings, and an end-to-end architecture walkthrough that ties every day's component together.

criteria.name: Certification plan
criteria.description: Capstone mapped to exam guide sections, with a realistic one-week plan for the gaps.
